what: The reviewer sign-off pharmadelta serves: one entry per sign-off, each a seat holder's review of a downloadable evidence package, with the record of the signature and the record of the package it signed (milestones/M06/README.md). The sign-off is built in this repository's website layer; it is not an agentkeel seat and not a platform control, and the platform does not read it (SPEC/00 §5). A number in this file is a seat's, SPEC/00's or a record's own, never a measured result.
agent: label-impact, agentkeel-studio/label-impact, the deployed agent (SPEC/00 §3, §6); its seven seats are read from its manifest.yaml
company: Ardentia Generics is fictional; its portfolio and every 'our label' statement are invented (SPEC/00 §2, §9)
seats: one person holds all seven seats on this project (agentkeel ruling R1, ADR-0001), so the reviewer is the author of every pull request in this repository; every page that shows a seat says so (SPEC/00 §5). Pharmacovigilance and Legal hold no seat and never appear as a signature.
